observed.summary: A creator films a first-person baking session: scoring and baking a sourdough loaf, ending with a cross-section reveal of the crumb. No spoken narration; on-screen text captions each step.

hook.description: Close-up of a razor scoring the dough surface in one long stroke, with a sharp sizzle sound.

observed.narrative_evidence: Three observed beats: scoring the dough (0.0-8.0), oven spring time-lapse with rising loaves (8.0-15.0), sliced crumb close-up (15.0-21.5). No spoken story; progression is purely visual.

shots.visual_description: Extreme close-up of floured dough being scored by hand in warm kitchen light.

audio.sfx: sharp scraping sizzle as blade cuts crust

shots.visual_description: Time-lapse of two loaves rising inside a domestic oven through the glass door.
Macro shot of a knife pulling away to reveal an open, airy crumb with steam.

concept.value: Satisfying process video showing sourdough from scoring to crumb reveal, optimized for visual payoff at the end.
concept.rationale: Visual progression is unambiguous across all three shots.

target_audience_hypothesis.rationale: Caption hashtags (#baking #bread) plus tutorial-style text overlays.

hook_type.rationale: First two seconds are a tactile extreme close-up with sharp SFX rather than speech or a question.

hook_mechanism.label: tactile_satisfying_open
hook_mechanism.rationale: Scoring close-up plus crisp audio creates immediate sensory engagement.

generation.global_brief: Recreate a ~21s vertical process video: three shots moving from tactile macro scoring, to oven rise, to crumb payoff. No dialogue; minimal text overlays; natural kitchen palette.
generation.timeline_pacing: Shot lengths approximately 8s / 7s / 6.5s; hold the opening macro static for at least 2s before any movement.
generation.text_treatment: Short lowercase step captions, top-center, appearing within 1s of each shot start; exact wording may be adapted but keep under six words.
generation.transitions: Jump cut into shot 2, straight cut into shot 3.
continuity_constraints: Same loaf and same kitchen lighting across shots 1 and 3.
Steam must be visible in the final crumb shot.
generation.payoff_timing: Crumb reveal must land between 15s and 17s so the payoff sits in the final quarter.

shots.reconstruction_intent: Static macro of a blade scoring dough in one continuous stroke; emphasize crisp scraping audio.
Time-lapse of loaves rising behind oven glass with upbeat acoustic music.
Slow pull-back revealing open crumb with steam; crust crackle SFX under continuing music.
